Written by server/scripts/generate-horse-flop-shown-vectors.ts; every card is invented. Do not edit by hand.

named.name: a continuation bet shown as top set; a person calls out of position with one pair, shown, and loses the call
the same hand, the caller a Horse: the same cell of the other kind
the caller mucks: his cards are not on the record and he is counted unshown
a mucked showdown entry is never read, even if cards were written for him
the bettor mucks: his bet has no class; the shown caller wins and his return is counted
cards without a showdown entry are not public: nothing about the bettor, the caller unshown
hole cards written on the actions change nothing
a lead by the caller is a first bet, not a continuation bet; the raiser calls in position with a draw
a raise closes the calls: a call after the raise is not a call of his bet; the caller before it is
two callers of one bet: the first out of position to the second, both counted; one shown in position with a draw
a double-board hand with two flops has no single flop: nothing
a second board that shares the flop keeps it
a bomb pot is not read
no winners list or no big blind: the bet is still classed, the calls are not counted
a hold-em hand (two hole cards) has no class; its call is still counted, unshown
a first flop wager that is an all-in short of a bet: the flop has no clean first bet
damaged amounts, a caller with an unknown origin, a card that is not a card: no error
a showdown entry shows a hand only with mucked: false written out; no flag, null or a string is not shown
the bettor shown with mucked: false; the caller listed with mucked: null is counted unshown
